text:
ada: Heads-up: discovered a perf regression in streaming vs non-streaming microbench on the new kernel picker build (bump from 1.8.2 -> 1.9.0).
liam: ugh, saw increased tail p95 on streaming? numbers?
ada: streaming p95 +18ms on short sequences (32 tokens), non-streaming stable. Overall throughput similar.
nora: can you paste the harness command you used?
ada: bench command: 
```
./bench/replay_harness --model=gptx-small --mode=streaming --chunk_sz=64 --clients=64 --qps=200 --kv-warmup=off
```
ada: same run with --mode=nonstreaming shows p95 within baseline.
bench-bot: CI results uploaded: https://benchlogs.internal/runs/1921001234
ryan: interesting: did kernel selector flip to aten_fused for streaming? that was enabled in 1.9.0.
ada: yes, kernel_profile shows aten_fused selected for attention at seq_len=32.
kevin: aten_fused tends to have higher per-chunk latency on small chunk sizes because of launch overhead. Could explain +18ms.
liam: but why only for streaming? non-streaming uses larger internal batches -> kernel choice different?
nora: streaming chunking creates many small subcalls; kernel selector uses estimated batch size = clients * chunk_parallelism. For streaming that's underestimated due to KV cache reuse.
ryan: we should reproduce with synthetic load that mimics client pacing + KV hit patterns rather than pure replay. Replay harness might under-represent interleaving.
ada: I ran a replay with explicit kv-warmup=on and the regression goes away. So KV cold miss interacts with kernel choice.
kevin: that suggests we need apples-to-apples: run replay with same KV-hit ratio as production (we currently default to 0.2).
liam: what about client readloop backpressure? If readloop stalls, inflight drops and selector picks a different kernel.
ada: captured flamegraph from the streaming run: main hotspots are readloop socket_poll -> client_dispatch -> small_attention_kernel.
bench-bot: attached: /artifacts/1921001234/flame.svg
nora: thanks. Let's add a deterministic microbenchmark that toggles: (1) kernel selector fixed to aten_fused, (2) fixed to cuda_native. Compare streaming/nonstreaming for chunk sizes [16,32,64,128].
ryan: also test with KV warmup variants: cold, partial (50%), warmed. We need a matrix.
ada: I'll spin up runs overnight. Plan: 3 seeds per cell, 120s warmup, 10k queries.
liam: logging: include kernel_selector decision trace per request (lightweight). Add --trace-kernel-decisions flag.
kevin: Perf regression triage note: probable root cause interaction between new aten_fused microkernel and streaming's small-chunk patterns when KV miss rate > 30%. Fix options: fallback to cuda_native for chunk_len<=32 or add cheaper kernel-launch path in aten_fused.
nora: before coding fallback, can we mitigate via batching heuristics? Increase chunk aggregation window (client-side) to combine subchunks for the kernel?
ryan: that would change streaming semantics/latency. Better to tune selector to predict effective batch size using KV hit estimation.
ada: adding that to TODO. Also noticed increased memory copying in aten_fused path for prepacked keys; will profile memcpy counts.
bench-bot: scheduled matrix runs: https://benchplanner.internal/suites/1921001234 (ETA: 12h) :hourglass:
liam: for apples-to-apples, ensure replay harness uses same client readloop pacing: set --client-pacing=poisson with mean=25ms, and include jitter=5ms.
ada: noted. Also recording: sample logs where kernel decision flips mid-request when KV cache warms between chunks.
kevin: action items:
- ada: run matrix and upload traces + flamegraphs
- liam: add --trace-kernel-decisions and ensure low-overhead
- nora: prototype selector heuristic that uses KV-hit ratio to bias kernel choice
- ryan: investigate memcpy and launch overhead in aten_fused on small chunks

ada: tagging @eng-runtime for visibility. Will post summary once runs finish.
liam: thanks, team. If regressions persist after selector tweaks we can revert aten_fused flag for streaming builds. :thumbsup:
kevin: also add a short doc snippet to devex about how to configure replay harness for faithful streaming emulation.
nora: +1, that'll reduce noisy tickets.
ada: final note: the regression only shows up on GPU type gtx-a100x2 in our infra; other GPUs less affected.
ryan: GPU-specific kernel-launch scheduling differences, good clue.
bench-bot: run matrix completed (partial): https://benchlogs.internal/runs/1921001234/partial - summary: aten_fused=on + streaming + kv_cold -> p95 +22ms; aten_fused=off -> baseline.
ada: uploading artifacts and opening a PR with selector change draft.
